question:
I work with SQL. These are my columns:

  1. week_start as a date, every monday of the year.
  2. delivery_time as a value in days, how long the delivery will take.
  3. safety_stock as a min value we should have materials in our warehouse.
  4. stock as amount of materials we have.
  5. order_amount as the amount we order.
  6. Needed as needed amount for that week.

Order, in case stock minus needed is below safety_stock we order the order_amount as value.

In case we ordered something we add it to the stock column into the week_start row where the delivery will arrive.

Example case:

weekstart delivery_time safety_stock stock order_amount order needed
06-01-2025 14 10 8 20 20 5
13-01-2025 14 10 3 20 20 2
20-01-2025 14 10 21 20 0 5

I couldnt figure out how to do this, I am thankful for any help! I tried to solve this recursively but I didnt find a way to variably specify the previous row. The first challenge is to find the correct row to check if the order was placed. The next challenge is to get the order_amount and add it to the right row to the stock value and check if an order needs to be placed. And this repeatingly.

Thanks!!

I expect that I can make this calculate as variable as possible. Reference previous rows (doesnt have to be just one row, can be multiple rows above) result and take it into the account into the current row. I cant use a cte and join them, because depending on a rows result, the follwing rows results will change, and this repeatingly.

Here is how I start:

 Recusion as (
 --base case 
        select ot.* 
        from original_table as ot 
        where ot.week_start = (select min(week_start) from ot)) 

 union all 
 --recursion
        select r.*
        from original_table as r
        inner join
        original_table w
        on r.week_start = dateadd(day, 7, w.week_start)        
        where (r.week_start < (select max(week_start) from 
        original_table )))

The challenge in the recursion part is to get the right row and check if there was an order, by considering that there may have been an order before and that there are 'left overs'.
title: Calculate a columns value based on another columns result of previous rows above and take it in acccount for current and following rows SQL
answer:
Snowflake allows recursion via WITH RECURSIVE, so recursion moves week by week, calculating stock dynamically. This handles any number of previous weeks because each row checks all previous rows for deliveries arriving this week.

WITH RECURSIVE stock_calc AS (
    SELECT
        week_start, delivery_time, safety_stock,
        stock, order_amount, needed,
        CASE 
            WHEN stock - needed < safety_stock THEN order_amount
            ELSE 0
        END AS order_placed,
        stock - needed AS stock_after,
        ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(
            OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(
                'delivery_week', CASE WHEN stock - needed < safety_stock THEN week_start + delivery_time ELSE NULL END,
                'amount', CASE WHEN stock - needed < safety_stock THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END
            )
        ) AS pending_deliveries
    FROM original_table
    WHERE week_start = (SELECT MIN(week_start) FROM original_table)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ot.week_start,
        ot.delivery_time,
        ot.safety_stock,
        prev.stock_after + COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN d.value:delivery_week::DATE = ot.week_start THEN d.value:amount::NUMBER
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS stock,
        ot.order_amount,
        ot.needed,
        CASE 
            WHEN (prev.stock_after + COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE 
                    WHEN d.value:delivery_week::DATE = ot.week_start THEN d.value:amount::NUMBER
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) - ot.needed) < ot.safety_stock 
            THEN ot.order_amount
            ELSE 0
        END AS order_placed,
        (prev.stock_after + COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN d.value:delivery_week::DATE = ot.week_start THEN d.value:amount::NUMBER
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) - ot.needed) AS stock_after,
        ARRAY_APPEND(
            ARRAY_FILTER(prev.pending_deliveries, d -> d.value:delivery_week::DATE > ot.week_start),
            OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(
                'delivery_week', CASE WHEN (prev.stock_after + COALESCE(SUM(
                    CASE WHEN d.value:delivery_week::DATE = ot.week_start THEN d.value:amount::NUMBER ELSE 0 END
                ),0) - ot.needed) < ot.safety_stock THEN ot.week_start + ot.delivery_time ELSE NULL END,
                'amount', CASE WHEN (prev.stock_after + COALESCE(SUM(
                    CASE WHEN d.value:delivery_week::DATE = ot.week_start THEN d.value:amount::NUMBER ELSE 0 END
                ),0) - ot.needed) < ot.safety_stock THEN ot.order_amount ELSE 0 END
            )
        ) AS pending_deliveries
    FROM original_table ot
    JOIN stock_calc prev
        ON ot.week_start = prev.week_start + 7
    , LATERAL FLATTEN(input => prev.pending_deliveries) d
)
SELECT week_start, stock, stock_after, order_placed
FROM stock_calc
ORDER BY week_start;
